# LLM-BANANA

# Game rules

## The room

You and two other monkeys are locked in a room with one armed bomb.

A wrong action detonates it. All three of you die. There is no second attempt.

No two bombs are built alike, and nothing says in advance what this one carries. It
reaches you only as your own view reveals it; the rest of it exists for you only
through the other two.

You each hold a different piece of what it takes. Work together.

## The three monkeys

| Monkey | Can | Cannot |
|---|---|---|
| Deaf | See the bomb: every colour and marking printed on it | Hear anything, or touch the bomb |
| Mute | Read the manual | Speak, or touch the bomb |
| Blind | Reach the bomb: feel it and work its parts | See a colour, a gesture, or anything merely printed |

You are shown your own share at the start of every round, and never anyone else's.

## Speech

Speech is a voice, not a screen. It carries words, numbers and ordinary punctuation,
and nothing else. Writing a gesture symbol into your sentence means you make that
gesture while you talk. Whoever can hear receives your words; whoever can see receives
the gestures you made. A listener who cannot see gets a blank where each gesture was; a
watcher who cannot hear gets the gestures and none of the words.

A mark that has no name cannot be pronounced: whoever holds one can describe it, never
read it out.

## Gestures

A gesture is made with the hands, using only the symbols in the alphabet below.
Whoever can see receives it; whoever cannot receives one blank per symbol, so they
know something was signalled but not what. Nothing gestured is ever heard.

👍 👎 👌 ☝ ✌ 🤟 🖐 ✋ 👆 👇 👈 👉 🫱 🫲 🫳 🫴 🫷 🫸 🤛 🤜 ✊ 👊 👋 🤚 🖖 🤌 🤏 🤞 🫰 🤘 🤙 👏 🙌 🫶 👐 🤲 🤝 🙏 🫵 ✍ 💅 🤳

## Turns

The speaking order was drawn once at random and will never change: every round goes
Mute, Blind, Deaf. Whoever comes before you in a round is already heard by the time you are
asked, and what you send lands on whoever comes after you in that same round. Whatever
you missed reaches you at the start of the next one.

You may name who a message is for — `to="deaf"` — and then it goes to them alone:
nobody else receives any of it. Left unnamed, it reaches everyone able to perceive it.
You may send several messages in one turn, each to someone different.

## Calls

Every reply has two parts, in this order. First, your thinking, in plain prose: what
you believe the bomb is, what you just learned, and why you are sending what follows.
It reaches nobody and changes nothing, but it is not optional — a reply that is only a
code block is incomplete. Then your calls, all of them in one fenced code block, last.
Only what is inside the block is sent.

Nothing is executed: calls return nothing, and variables, conditionals and loops are
ignored. Write only literal top-level calls.

    ```
    speak(to="mute", text="there are three of them and the middle one is odd")
    gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✊", "✌"])
    wait()
    ```

If you have nothing worth sending, call wait(). Producing no call at all counts as the
same thing.

The program decides what happened, not you. Never claim an action took place unless it
was accepted.

# Your role: MUTE

You hold the manual. You cannot speak, you never see the bomb, and you cannot touch it.

## Your channels

When you gesture, Deaf receives it.
You cannot speak.

## Your reach

You cannot act. What this bomb can be made to do is for the one who can reach it to
find under their own hands.

# Hints

- Three of you, three different worlds. Before sending anything, stand where the
  receiver stands. What reaches them at all, what does your message turn into on
  arrival, and what do they already know?

- Trace who can actually reach whom before you start. Some of you only connect
  through a third.

- A sign means nothing until somebody has made it mean something.

TURN 1
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Anything the bomb offers in print is bait, and taking the bait
is the fuse. The only way out is the cut below.

| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | red |
| green | green |
| yellow | blue |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
(empty)

The manual gives a three-row mapping: blue light means red wire, green means green, and yellow means blue. Since Deaf can see both the bomb and my gestures, I am encoding the three light colors in their manual order and the corresponding cut colors in order. The matching positions are 1→1, 2→2, and 3→3; Deaf can then tell Blind the actual colors aloud.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["☝", "☝"])
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✌", "✌"])
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🤟", "🤟"])
```

TURN 2
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Anything the bomb offers in print is bait, and taking the bait
is the fuse. The only way out is the cut below.

| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | red |
| green | green |
| yellow | blue |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: I feel the large button embossed PUSH TO DEFUSE. The display, light, and all three wires reveal nothing tactilely. Please use the manual to determine the safe operation.
Deaf says to Mute: I see display 0, yellow light, large button marked PUSH TO DEFUSE, and wires 1 red, 2 blue, 3 green. I also received your gesture pairs ☝☝, ✌✌, 🤟🤟, but do not know their meaning. Please use the manual to determine the required action and tell Blind.

The yellow light is the third row of the manual, which requires cutting the blue wire. Deaf can identify that as wire 2 from the bomb’s visible labels, then instruct Blind to cut wire 2 and press the large button. I will send the ordered numeric pair “3, 2,” using the familiar one-, two-, and three-finger signs; the first number is the manual row and the second is the wire number.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🤟", "✌"])
```

TURN 3
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Anything the bomb offers in print is bait, and taking the bait
is the fuse. The only way out is the cut below.

| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | red |
| green | green |
| yellow | blue |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Deaf reports display 0, yellow light, and wires: position 1 red, position 2 blue, position 3 green. I am taking no action pending the manual.
Deaf says to Mute: I see your new gestures 🤟 then ✌. Please state the manual's required operation aloud to Blind, including any wire, button, or display conditions.

The yellow light maps to cutting the blue wire. Deaf has already identified the blue wire as position 2 and can relay the operation to Blind. I will reinforce the full sequence visually: display 0, wire 2, cut, then press the button. The crossed fingers serve as the agreed visual cue for cutting, and the upward finger as pressing.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👌", "✌", "🤞", "👆"])
```

TURN 4
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Anything the bomb offers in print is bait, and taking the bait
is the fuse. The only way out is the cut below.

| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | red |
| green | green |
| yellow | blue |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: The two signs have no established meaning. For a yes-or-no answer, use the horns sign for YES and the victory sign for NO. Then signal exactly one sign answering: does the manual require pressing the large button?

The manual specifies that the only way out is the required wire cut; it does not require pressing the large button. I will send exactly one victory sign to Deaf, who can communicate the answer to Blind.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✌"])
```

TURN 5
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Anything the bomb offers in print is bait, and taking the bait
is the fuse. The only way out is the cut below.

| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | red |
| green | green |
| yellow | blue |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Please speak the relevant manual instruction aloud to me verbatim or in full: given display 0, yellow light, button marked PUSH TO DEFUSE, and wires red-blue-green, what exact action must Blind perform? Do not use gestures for this.
Deaf says to Mute: I see the single V sign ✌. Please tell Blind the manual's instruction in spoken words; I cannot hear your gestures.

I cannot speak, so I cannot deliver the instruction aloud directly. Deaf can see my sign and can speak to Blind. The yellow row requires cutting the blue wire, which Deaf identified as position 2; the manual does not require pressing the button. I will signal the wire position, while the already established V sign conveys “no” for pressing.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✌"])
```

TURN 6
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Anything the bomb offers in print is bait, and taking the bait
is the fuse. The only way out is the cut below.

| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | red |
| green | green |
| yellow | blue |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Your V sign means NO. Since pressing is NO, answer these three questions with exactly three signs in order, using horns for YES and V for NO: Is cutting wire 1 safe? Is cutting wire 2 safe? Is cutting wire 3 safe?
Deaf says to Mute: The V sign ✌ has been repeated. Blind cannot see it, so please encode its meaning using the agreed gesture descriptions or signal the complete manual instruction unambiguously.

Only wire 2 is safe: the yellow light requires cutting the blue wire, and Deaf identified blue as position 2. Therefore the answers are NO, YES, NO, encoded with the agreed V and horns signs, respectively.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✌", "🤘", "✌"])
```

TURN 7
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Anything the bomb offers in print is bait, and taking the bait
is the fuse. The only way out is the cut below.

| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | red |
| green | green |
| yellow | blue |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Please answer only this one question: does the manual say cutting wire 1 is safe? Signal exactly one sign: horns for YES, V for NO. Do not signal anything else.

Wire 1 is red, but the yellow light requires cutting the blue wire, so cutting wire 1 is not safe. I will send exactly one V sign for NO.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✌"])
```

TURN 8
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Anything the bomb offers in print is bait, and taking the bait
is the fuse. The only way out is the cut below.

| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | red |
| green | green |
| yellow | blue |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: I interpret your latest three signs as answers for wires 1, 2, and 3: NO, YES, NO. Before I act, confirm only wire 2: send exactly one horns sign if cutting wire 2 is safe, or exactly one V sign if it is not. No other signs.

Wire 2 is the blue wire, and the yellow light requires cutting blue, so cutting wire 2 is safe. I will send exactly one horns sign for YES.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🤘"])
```
